creative_direction: Draw a ribbon-like violet eel making a tight inward turn around a small lemon-yellow pinwheel. The eel has a flattened paper-like body, one tiny alert eye, and two simple fins that bend with the curve. Fold the tail beneath the head so the entire movement forms a compact circular composition. Use crisp graphic planes and a pale cyan background, with one dark teal shadow shape indicating the turn. The pinwheel blades should be broad and slightly uneven, suggesting rotation without blur. Keep the eel playful and natural rather than monster-like. Leave a clear center gap and avoid extra speed lines, water scenery, text, or decorative particles.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
